metadata.question: Did the land area of Great Fox Island decrease between 1999 and 2019?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about land area change of Great Fox Island between 1999 and 2019. This requires: 1. Finding Great Fox Island location - it appears to be in Virginia, USA 2. Using Landsat imagery from 1999 and 2019 to detect land/water boundaries 3. Calculating land area for both time periods and comparing Strategy: - Use Landsat 5 for 1999 and Landsat 8 for 2019 - Apply water detection using NDWI (Normalized Difference Water Index) - Count land pixels in both years and compare - Handle potential data gaps (Landsat 5 in 1999, Landsat 8 in 2019) Water detection: NDWI = (Green - NIR)/(Green + NIR) - Water typically has positive NDWI values - Land typically has negative NDWI values I'll define a geometry for Great Fox Island area and process both time periods. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define Great Fox Island area (Virginia, USA) const geometry = ee.Geometry.Polygon([[ [-75.33, 37.89], [-75.31, 37.89], [-75.31, 37.91], [-75.33, 37.91], [-75.33, 37.89] ]]); // Function to calculate NDWI for water detection function addNDWI(image) { const ndwi = image.normalizedDifference(['B2', 'B4']).rename('NDWI'); return image.addBands(ndwi); } // Function to calculate NDWI for Landsat 8 function addNDWI_L8(image) { const ndwi = image.normalizedDifference(['B3', 'B5']).rename('NDWI'); return image.addBands(ndwi); } // Get Landsat 5 collection for 1999 let landsat1999 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(geometry) .filterDate('1999-01-01', '1999-12-31') .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 20)) .map(addNDWI); // Get Landsat 8 collection for 2019 let landsat2019 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(geometry) .filterDate('2019-01-01', '2019-12-31') .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 20)) .map(addNDWI_L8); // Check if collections are empty const count1999 = landsat1999.size().getInfo(); const count2019 = landsat2019.size().getInfo(); console.log(`1999 Images: ${count1999}, 2019 Images: ${count2019}`); if (count1999 === 0 || count2019 === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // Get median composites const composite1999 = landsat1999.median(); const composite2019 = landsat2019.median(); // Create land masks (NDWI < 0 = land, NDWI > 0 = water) const landMask1999 = composite1999.select('NDWI').lt(0); const landMask2019 = composite2019.select('NDWI').lt(0); // Count land pixels const landCount1999 = landMask1999.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: geometry, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDWI'); const landCount2019 = landMask2019.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: geometry, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDWI'); const count1 = landCount1999.getInfo(); const count2 = landCount2019.getInfo(); console.log(`1999 Land Pixels: ${count1}, 2019 Land Pixels: ${count2}`); // Check for no valid pixels if (count1 === 0 || count2 === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // Check for calculation failure if (count1 === null || count2 === null || isNaN(count1) || isNaN(count2)) { console.log("C3"); return; } // Calculate area change const areaChange = ((count2 - count1) / count1 * 100); console.log(`Area Change: ${areaChange.toFixed(1)}%`); // Determine answer if (count2 < count1) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
